scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “An algebra of infinite little finitistic dimension” (preprints/An-algebra-of-infinite-little-finitistic-dimension-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 198 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1fb7f827f59dcca0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The algebra D has finite global dimension on both sides. Let F = X ⊗L D −. For every complex Z of left B-modules, regarded as a complex on the first factor of D, there is an isomorphism F2 (Z) ≃ P[b∗] ⊗L B Z, T ⊗L B⊗kC O ≃ P[b∗]. (5.2) The second isomorphism is an isomorphism of complexes of B-bimodules, and the first is supported on the first factor of D.
